translations.web: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war, and have shed blood.’
translations.bsb: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has shed blood.’
translations.kjv: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
translations.asv: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
